list.name: var_company
list.label: Company Filter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT server_meta->'asn'->>'org' FROM test_runs WHERE server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IS NOT NULL

list.name: var_asn
list.label: ASN Filter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT 'AS' || (server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') FROM test_runs WHERE server_meta->'asn'->>'asn' IS NOT NULL

list.name: var_country
list.label: Country Filter
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' FROM test_runs WHERE server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IS NOT NULL

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ${group_by:raw} AS group_name, AVG(test_runs.overall_score) AS overall, AVG(test_runs.entry_score) AS entry, AVG(test_runs.exit_score) AS exit, AVG(test_runs.relay_score) AS relay FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    ('ALL' IN (${var_company:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_asn:singlequote}) OR 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}) OR COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_country:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}) OR test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY overall DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT test_runs.test_id) AS matched FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    ('ALL' IN (${var_company:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_asn:singlequote}) OR 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}) OR COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_country:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}) OR test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))

SELECT test_runs.created_at AS "time", ${group_by:raw} AS metric, AVG(test_runs.overall_score) AS value FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    ('ALL' IN (${var_company:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_asn:singlequote}) OR 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}) OR COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_country:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}) OR test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ${group_by:raw} AS group_name, tr.method, COUNT(*) AS detections FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs ON test_runs.id = tr.test_run_id 
WHERE 
    ('ALL' IN (${var_company:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_asn:singlequote}) OR 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}) OR COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_country:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}) OR test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 AND tr.method IS NOT NULL AND tr.verdict = 'BLOCKED' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

SELECT test_runs.test_id, 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') AS asn, test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' AS org, COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') AS datacenter, test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'city' AS city, test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' AS country, test_runs.overall_score FROM test_runs 
WHERE 
    ('ALL' IN (${var_company:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'org' IN (${var_company:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_asn:singlequote}) OR 'AS' || (test_runs.server_meta->'asn'->>'asn') IN (${var_asn:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}) OR COALESCE(test_runs.server_meta->'datacenter'->>'name', 'No DC') IN (${var_datacenter:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_country:singlequote}) OR test_runs.server_meta->'location'->>'country_code' IN (${var_country:singlequote}))
    AND ('ALL' IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}) OR test_runs.test_id IN (${var_test_id:singlequote}))
 ORDER BY test_runs.overall_score ASC
